jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual prerendered background for a playable 2D isometric anime game. Use the attached town image ONLY as the visual style/camera/scale reference: an elevated orthographic-like isometric view, camera about 35 degrees downward, meticulously painted charming storybook anime scenery, natural watercolor-gouache surfaces, clear small-game-object readability, never pixel art, not a movie ground-level view. Create an original lush forest place outside that town. Wide 16:9 composition, landscape 1920x1080 intent. No UI, lettering, logos, people, animals or characters. No sky taking up the image; ground and trees fill the game map. Keep the main walkable path clearly visible, broad and unobstructed (about 160-250 pixels wide at a 1920-pixel canvas); paths must not disappear behind foreground canopies. Delightful moss, wildflowers, ferns, clover, mushrooms, pale worn stepping stones, leaf-filtered late-morning sun. Tree trunks must stand straight. Border foliage is richly detailed, open paths are calmer to read. Scene: Mosswood Trail. A broad sandy forest footpath enters the image through the LEFT edge at about 60% height, curves into a spacious sunny central meadow, then continues to a clearly open SOUTHEAST exit at the BOTTOM-RIGHT edge. A second curved branch of the path rejoins around the meadow, forming a walking loop. A very large ancient elm stands at the upper edge of the central meadow, with its visible exposed roots remaining outside the paths. To the far upper-left, only a tiny hint of the cream village walls beyond the trees suggests the route back to town. A small mossy boulder and wildflower patch form an inviting resting place on the meadow's north side. Dense beech, elm and willow forest surrounds the routes but leaves the entire main trail and loop walkable and visible. The lower-right exit must be a real continuous unobstructed path all the way to the image edge. No fences across the paths. Environment plate only.
